unsupported: The group was founded in 1953 by Franz W. Prettl in Germany and remains a family-owned business now in its third generation, led by Willi and Johannes Prettl.
The company began as a small enterprise and grew into a global operation.
Primary customers are in the automotive industry, particularly original equipment manufacturers and tier suppliers seeking electrification and connectivity solutions.
The company also serves the energy management sector and, as indicated by its ISO 13485 certification, the medical device market.
